title: HrReceipt
description: One HR event as the control plane received and decided it, for console administrators (D70). It names the person by their HR id only: nothing from the event's payload (email, job code, manager) is part of this schema.

personId.description: The HR system's stable id for the person.

occurredAt.description: When the HR system says the change took effect.

generation.description: The event's place in the person's accepted HR history; 0 for an ignored or legacy event.

decision.description: accepted: it changed what the person has. ignored: it was older than what the control plane already held. legacy: received before decisions were recorded.

dispatchState.description: Whether the event was handed to its workflow: pending (not yet), dispatched, ignored (never, because it was ignored), cancelled (withdrawn, for example by an erasure), legacy.

setupCompleted.description: The workflow no longer uses this event's HR details (email, manager). It is not a claim that the workflow, a grace period or provider clean-up has finished. Always false for ignored and legacy events.

identityMode.description: Whether agents get a directory identity in Entra or a simulated one.
